title: GAS SETS THE PRICE LESS OFTEN?
subtitle: In ERCOT the share barely moved; the sensitivity moves it more than the years do

chart.y_left_label: percent of hours below 7 x Henry Hub

callouts.label: ERCOT hours below gas fuel cost
ISO-NE hours below gas fuel cost

why: At 7 MMBtu per MWh, ERCOT's hub average sat below a gas plant's fuel cost in 38.8 percent of 2019's hours and 40.9 percent of 2025's (8,760 hours). The heat rate matters: at 6.5 ERCOT's 2025 share is 35.3 percent and at 8.0 it is 52.8. An hour below fuel cost is an hour when something cheaper than gas set the price, or gas sold below its cost; the share says how often, not which. Henry Hub is the national benchmark;
footnote: Data: real-time prices by local hour, 2019 to 2026: ERCOT: HB_HUBAVG, the mean of the four 15-minute settlement point prices in the local hour, 2019-01-01 00:00 to 2026-11-04 23:00 (68,736 hours, America/Chicago); CAISO: TH_SP15_GEN-APND, the mean of the four 15-minute interval means in the local hour, 2026-08-26 00:00 to 2026-11-04 23:00 (1,681 hours, America/Los_Angeles); SPP: SPPSOUTH_HUB, the mean of the four 15-minute interval means in the local hour, 2026-09-24 00:00 to 2026-10-31 23:00 (720 hours, America/Chicago). Gas: Henry Hub daily spot (EIA), the calendar month's mean applied to every hour of the month. An hour counts when its price is below heat rate x Henry Hub; shares are percent of the year's held hours; 7 MMBtu/MWh on the card, 6.5 and 8.0 in the hover. A year a grid's history does not cover is not held and not filled. ISO-NE's hourly history is an internal table: only these aggregates are published. MISO paused, PJM licensed: placeholders. ISO-NE, MISO, NYISO: license needed (the publisher's terms ask for written permission, and none is recorded); their figures are left out of this card and its data.
source_line: Source: ERCOT, CAISO OASIS, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP real-time prices; EIA Henry Hub spot; ERW tables ercot_all_hub_prices_history, iso_rtm_hub_prices, nyiso_rtm_zone_prices, isone_zone_prices_history, eia_fuel_spot_prices.
csv_header: Energy Research Warehouse (ERW): finding gas_sets_price, GAS SETS THE PRICE LESS OFTEN?
Rows: one per grid and local year: held hours and the percent of them with the real-time price below heat rate x Henry Hub (6.5, 7.0, 8.0)
A blank is a year the warehouse does not hold for that grid. Sources: ercot_all_hub_prices_history, iso_rtm_hub_prices, nyiso_rtm_zone_prices, isone_zone_prices_history, eia_fuel_spot_prices
